name: Pension Wieser
beschreibung:
Overview

Apart Hotel Garni Wieser is a 3-star bike hotel in a panoramic location above Sölden in the Ötztal in Tyrol. The house is located at Panoramastraße 33 and offers both rooms and apartments. Guests stay in a quiet, elevated setting with views of Sölden and the Ötztal Alps, while the town centre is reachable in around 12 minutes on foot. In summer the house is a starting point for hikes and bike tours; in winter it lies directly on the valley run and enables ski-in/ski-out. The double and triple rooms measure 20 to 26 m², the apartments 30 to 54 m², plus XXL apartments of up to 139 m² for groups of up to ten people.

History/Background

Apart Hotel Garni Wieser is described as a family-run house and is a partner of "Bike Homes Ötztal". The accommodation is classified as a 3-star house and is located on Panoramastraße slightly above Sölden. Its amenities include the Zirbenwald sauna area with a Finnish sauna, bio sauna, infrared cabin and relaxation room. The official sources do not provide confirmed information on its founding history, so only the documented facts are reproduced here.

Getting There

The journey leads through the Ötztal to Sölden. The house is located at Panoramastraße 33, 6450 Sölden, slightly above the town centre; from the centre it is about a 12-minute walk. A free parking space is available at the hotel. The valley run passes directly by the house; alternatively, the ski bus or local bus can be used. The nearest public transport stop is only a few metres away.

Tips

For room guests the breakfast buffet is included; apartment guests can add it flexibly or use the bread roll service. In winter, the descent starts right at the doorstep toward the Giggijochbahn, which climbs to an altitude of 2,284 metres. In summer the Summer Card is included: it covers, among other things, free use of several Ötztal mountain railways and, in selected periods, also admissions such as AQUA DOME and AREA 47. Hiking and bike tours start right at the house; the region is known as Bike Republic Sölden. After a day in the mountains, the Zirbenwald sauna area is available.

Best Time to Travel

Sölden is a destination in both winter and summer. The ski season in the Sölden ski area generally runs from autumn into spring, and the glacier ski area allows an early start to the season. The summer months are ideal for hiking and biking. Exact season and opening times of the house should be requested directly from the establishment or via the official website.
